guides.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package thermal-cycling reliability: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：記錄溫差、停留、升降速率及失效位置。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Record range, dwell, ramp rate and failure location. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「記錄溫差、停留、升降速率及失效位置」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Record range, dwell, ramp rate and failure location, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Package thermal-cycling reliability: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義服役溫度史」建立判讀邊界。幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define service thermal history to define the interpretation boundary. Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義服役溫度史：觀察焦點：列完整時間軸而非只寫高低溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜定位首發失效：觀察焦點：結合分段測試與影像縮小位置。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成可靠度結論：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：寫出資料能支持與不能支持的壽命主張。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define service thermal history: Observation focus: Record a full timeline, not only extremes. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Locate first failure: Observation focus: Combine segmented testing and imaging to localize. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete reliability conclusion: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: State which life claims the data support and do not support. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「定位首發失效」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成可靠度結論：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Locate first failure: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete reliability conclusion: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定義服役溫度史」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定位首發失效」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到串聯菊鏈只指出某段異常，不能直接識別每個焊點。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for define service thermal history actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage.

Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for locate first failure actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A daisy chain identifies a faulty segment, not automatically the individual joint.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 本課以溫度循環歷史、CTE 失配及失效統計連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
courses.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through thermal-cycle history, cte mismatch and failure statistics. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.
